name: ja-denki-simulator
description: JAでんき vs 中国電力 料金比較シミュレーター

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ja-denki-simulator/calc-core && npm run build -w @ja-denki-simulator/web
scripts.test: npm test -w @ja-denki-simulator/calc-core && npm test -w @ja-denki-simulator/web && npm run test:scripts
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @ja-denki-simulator/calc-core && npm run test:coverage -w @ja-denki-simulator/web && vitest run --coverage
